euclid-elements.author: Euclid
euclid-elements.locus: Book II Prop. 11; Book IV Prop. 10–11; Book VI Def. 3 & Prop. 30; Book XIII Prop. 1–10
euclid-elements.note: Sir Thomas L. Heath, The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements, Cambridge University Press, 1908 (GEOMETOR Digital Scriptorium edition).

ptolemy-almagest.author: Claudius Ptolemy
ptolemy-almagest.note: G. J. Toomer (trans.), Ptolemy's Almagest, Duckworth / Springer, 1984.

kepler-1597.author: Johannes Kepler
kepler-1597.note: First explicit derivation of the right triangle with sides in geometric progression 1 : √φ : φ.

hooper-1794.author: William Hooper
hooper-1794.note: Early geometric missing-area rectangle dissection later generalized by Sam Loyd, Martin Gardner, and Paul Curry.

lemoine-1902.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1902.work: Géométrographie ou Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine-1902.note: Foundational treatise quantifying operational simplicity of straightedge-and-compass constructions; see also J. Reusch, Planimetrische Konstruktionen in geometrographischer Ausführung (1904).

huntley-1970.author: H. E. Huntley
huntley-1970.work: The Divine Proportion: A Study in Mathematical Beauty
huntley-1970.note: Classic exposition including the angle-bisector circle division in the 3-4-5 right triangle.

odom-coxeter-1983.author: George Odom & H. S. M. Coxeter
odom-coxeter-1983.note: Equilateral-triangle midline extended to the circumcircle yields the golden section.

hofstetter-2002.author: Kurt Hofstetter
hofstetter-2002.work: A Simple Construction of the Golden Section
hofstetter-2002.note: Five-circle Mascheroni compass-only construction of the golden section.

hofstetter-2003.author: Kurt Hofstetter
hofstetter-2003.work: 5-Step Division of a Segment in the Golden Section
hofstetter-2003.note: Minimal 5-step straightedge-and-compass internal division of a given segment.

hofstetter-2004.author: Kurt Hofstetter
hofstetter-2004.work: Another 5-Step Division of a Segment in the Golden Section
hofstetter-2004.note: Alternative 5-step straightedge-and-compass division using three circles and two lines.

hofstetter-2005.author: Kurt Hofstetter
hofstetter-2005.work: Division of a Segment in the Golden Section with Ruler and Rusty Compass
hofstetter-2005.note: Fixed-opening (rusty) compass construction dividing a unit segment in φ.

prasolov-2006.author: V. V. Prasolov
prasolov-2006.note: Affine equi-area characterization of golden diagonal ratios in irregular convex pentagons.

kocik-2010.author: Jerzy Kocik
kocik-2010.note: Six-circle Apollonian window packing forcing powers of φ, golden rectangles, and Kepler's triangle.

bataille-2011.author: Michel Bataille
bataille-2011.work: Another Simple Construction of the Golden Section
bataille-2011.note: Constructs φ from an equilateral triangle and square erected on the same segment.
